verdict.rationale: Graphite ships a built-in Agent: users describe a task in plain language, and it pulls repository context, generates the changes, and opens a draft PR (graphite-docs-12). It can also be launched from the PR page to commit changes directly to the branch (graphite-docs-22, graphite-docs-52). Graphite Chat adds in-product delegation of fixes, CI-failure diagnosis and edits (graphite-docs-7, graphite-docs-8, graphite-docs-29). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the agent delegation works well in practice; evidence is first-party docs only.
